prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original grayscale status-bar fill texture for JiberishUI, a World of Warcraft addon. Create a restrained HAND-PAINTED FANTASY STONE material that belongs beside sculpted Warcraft armor and carved stone UI artwork. It should read as one solid, worn, gently hewn stone face: mostly smooth broad areas with a few very shallow elongated chisel planes and quiet brush-painted value shifts. Minimal detail; clean and legible after tinting pink, green or blue behind small white health numbers. The small amount of wear should feel deliberately painted by a fantasy game texture artist, not a photographed material. Broad calm horizontal flow, soft upper-left painted highlights, subtle lower shading, occasional short faint mineral seams. Keep the center band especially uncluttered. Light-medium NEUTRAL GRAYSCALE with a narrow value range. Full-bleed opaque surface viewed straight on, wide 3:1 image, continuous material to every edge. This will be center-cropped to a narrow 8:1 health bar. No discrete border, framing, icons, symbols, text, runes, gemstones, metal, decorative carvings or any embedded objects. No crumpled paper, polygonal wrinkles, lumpy facets, pebbles, photographic concrete, sandpaper noise, deep cracks, speckles, dramatic contrast, shine or glass. Minimal stylized solid stone, designed for a polished fantasy MMO interface. Entirely original artwork.
purpose: Original minimal hand-painted fantasy stone for small class-tinted status bars. SharedMedia JiberishUI Stone and all health variants use this source. No reference-addon assets used.
